name: scouvela
description: Apify Actor that discovers public growth opportunities for African SMEs from curated websites and public social pages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @scouvela/shared && npm run build -w @scouvela/actor
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @scouvela/shared && npm run typecheck -w @scouvela/actor
scripts.test: npm run build -w @scouvela/shared && npm run test -w @scouvela/actor
scripts.check:actor: npm run build -w @scouvela/shared && npm run typecheck -w @scouvela/actor && npm test -w @scouvela/actor && npm run lint -w @scouvela/actor
